title: Coastal Soul 393
meta_description: Coastal Soul 393: Pet-friendly cottage near Gulf \& bay with boat parking, 2 king suites, fenced yard \& close beach access.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Welcome to Coastal Soul 393, a quaint, pet friendly cottage near the ocean and the bay. Enjoy all the comforts of home, after a day on the water, fishing, boating and sunbathing. If you're looking for a home close to a boat ramp that has room to park your boat too, then look no further. Coastal Soul 393 is less than a quarter mile to the Cessna Landing Park.

The open concept living, dining and kitchen will keep you connected while you reminisce about your day and enjoy your meals together. There are two king master bedrooms upstairs with ensuite bathrooms and a twin daybed and sleeper sofa on the first floor.

ABOUT THE AREA: Coastal Soul is just around the corner from Cessna Landing on the Choctawatchee Bay. The park has a boat launch, docks, picnic shelters, basketball court, squash court, and playground. Towards the beach, it's closest to Gulf Place which features some of 30A's most popular restaurants, like Shunk Gulley and The Perfect Pig. Gulf Place was specifically designed to slow folks down with beautiful palm tree-lined streets, wide sidewalks, outdoor patios with large umbrellas, nature walking trails, plentiful green spaces, and park benches to sit and enjoy the views. If you're looking for a little more, then Grand Boulevard, Baytowne Wharf and Destin are not far away.

BEACH ACCESS: Ed Walline Regional Beach Access is the closest beach to Coastal Soul. From the house, head south on 393, cross over Hwy 98 and then at the intersection of 393 and 30A you'll see Ed Walline. This beach is ADA accessible, and has two picnic shelters, parking, restrooms, and beach wheelchairs and lifeguards during peak season.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 -- King Bed with ensuite bath (2nd Floor)
• Bedroom 2 -- King bed, with ensuite bath, balcony (2nd Floor)
• Twin day bed on first floor
• Sleeper sofa in living room

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Less than a half mile to Cessna Boat Landing
• Boat parking on property (max 26ft)
• 2 Bikes
• Centrally located between Destin and Panama City
• Private fenced in yard
• Outdoor Grill
• Close to beach and bay
• Full size Washer \& Dryer
• Self-Check-In
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath towels, wash clothes, etc.
• Fully stocked kitchen

\*\*\* Boat Friendly
\*\*\* Pet Friendly (2 dogs - $250/dog)

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- This home allows up to 2 pets for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine per pet.

Parking Details:
- Please make sure you park in the designated property parking locations only. If your home offers street parking please make sure you read all posted signage.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
